baseline: In-process native code always checks fuel, and every normal run flushes stdout and stderr
candidate: Unbounded instances run code without fuel checks (standard host and the site example runner opt in), and a normal run leaves output to stdio buffering as the engine does
methodology: Physical Alpha. Examples: the site in-process ZX runner built from each revision (the candidate with -DMATRIX_ZX_UNBOUNDED) on the same bundles, 7 alternating rounds, results checked. Standard: standard-ab with each revision's bench/standard/host.c and bundle, CPU 3, 5 rounds, C digest checked. strace counted one write per entry before the flush change.

examples.unit: µs per call, median of each run's 11 batch medians
